manifest.name.description: The extension's name in the browser's extension list and in the store. A product name: keep it as it is.

manifest.description.message: Send the tab you're looking at to your phone or another computer. One click, end-to-end encrypted.
manifest.description.description: One-sentence summary under the name in the browser's extension list and the store. Chrome allows at most 132 characters.

manifest.actionTitle.description: Tooltip when the pointer rests on the toolbar icon. Short; it also shows next to the icon in the extensions menu.

manifest.command.execute.message: Do what clicking the Tabsend icon does
manifest.command.execute.description: Name of the keyboard shortcut that does what the toolbar icon does, in the browser's shortcut settings. Short.

manifest.command.sendToPrimary.message: Send this tab in one click to your “Send to” device (4 seconds to undo)
manifest.command.sendToPrimary.description: Name of the second keyboard shortcut, in the browser's shortcut settings. “Send to” is the name of a setting in Tabsend's settings page (see options.sending.sendTo); 4 seconds is the undo window.
